name: Financial Assistance for Natural Death
benefit: - **Financial assistance of ₹2,00,000/- is provided by the Board to the legal heir of a registered worker who dies due to natural death.**
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be the legal heir of the deceased construction worker. 1. The deceased construction worker should be registered under the Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board. 1. The death of the deceased worker must be due to natural death.
